# OpenGeo Cambodia API — full reference

> Free, keyless, read-only REST API for Cambodia's administrative geography: 25 provinces, 210 districts, 1,661 communes and 14,576 villages (16,472 places) with official NCDD codes, Khmer and English names, GeoJSON boundaries and geocoding.

Generated 2026-11-09 from the API itself: the endpoint list comes from the Postman collection and every example response below is a real response captured in-process. The short index is at https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/llms.txt.

## Essentials

- **Base URL:** `https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me` (local development: `http://localhost:3000`).
- **Auth:** none. No API key, no signup. CORS is open, so browsers can call it directly.
- **User-Agent required:** requests without a `User-Agent` header get `403` `{"success":false,"error":"Access Denied: Missing User-Agent header."}`. Browsers send one automatically; set it explicitly in scripts and agent tools.
- **Methods:** GET only. Other methods return `405`.
- **Formats:** JSON (UTF-8, Khmer script included). Boundary geometry is GeoJSON (`application/geo+json`).
- **Speed:** administrative and boundary data is served from memory and edge-cached; typical server time is under 1 ms (see the `X-Response-Time` header). Geocoding calls OpenStreetMap Nominatim and is slower.

### Rate limits (per IP, rolling 1-minute window)

| Endpoints | Limit |
| --- | --- |
| `/api/admin/*`, `/api/boundaries/*` | 10,000 / min |
| `/api/admin/search` | 120 / min |
| `/api/geocode/*` | 30 / min (OpenStreetMap Nominatim fair use) |
| other `/api/*` | 5,000 / min |

Every response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset` (Unix seconds); a `429` means wait until the reset time.
Administrative and boundary responses are cacheable for a year (`Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, s-maxage=31536000, immutable, stale-while-revalidate=86400`) and carry an `ETag`; send `If-None-Match` to get `304 Not Modified`.

## Data model

Cambodia has four administrative levels. Every place has an official NCDD **code** whose leading digits are its parents' codes, so a code alone tells you its whole ancestry.

| Level | Khmer types | Code digits | Count | Boundary polygons |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| province | រាជធានី (capital), ខេត្ត | 2 | 25 | 25 |
| district | ក្រុង, ស្រុក, ខណ្ឌ | 4 | 210 | 197 |
| commune | ឃុំ, សង្កាត់ | 6 | 1,661 | 1,633 |
| village | ភូមិ | 8 | 14,576 | none (no polygons) |

A real chain, from `GET /api/admin/hierarchy/12010101`:

- province `12`: Phnom Penh (រាជធានីភ្នំពេញ; type រាជធានី)
- district `1201`: Chamkar Mon (ចំការមន; type ខណ្ឌ)
- commune `120101`: Tonle Basak (ទន្លេបាសាក់; type សង្កាត់)
- village `12010101`: Phum Muoy (ភូមិ ១; type ភូមិ)

**id vs code.** Admin endpoints (`/api/admin/*`) use the numeric **id**, which is the code without leading zeros (commune code `070203` → id `70203`). Boundary endpoints (`/api/boundaries/*`) use the zero-padded **code** (`070203`); P-codes like `KH070203` are also accepted.

### AdminItem (every `/api/admin` record)

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | number | Numeric code; use it in admin URLs. |
| `code` | string | Official NCDD code, zero-padded (2/4/6/8 digits). |
| `name`, `name_en` | string | Romanised name (`name` mirrors `name_en`). |
| `name_km` | string | Khmer script name. |
| `level` | `province` \| `district` \| `commune` \| `village` | |
| `typeKm` | string | Khmer unit type, e.g. `ខេត្ត`, `ខណ្ឌ`, `សង្កាត់`, `ភូមិ`. |
| `parentId` | number? | Parent's id; absent on provinces. |
| `lat`, `lon` | number? | Approximate centroid, where available (provinces always). |

Records also contain internal search fields starting with `_` (`_normEn`, `_normKm`, `_normName`). Ignore them; they are not part of the contract. They are omitted from the examples below.

### Boundary feature properties

`code`, `pcode` (`KH` + code), `name_en`, `name_km`, `type_km`, `level`, `province_code` / `province_name_en` / `province_name_km`, `district_code` / `district_name_en` / `district_name_km` (communes), `lat`, `lon` (centroid), `bbox` (`[minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat]`), `shape_length`, `shape_area`. `format=summary` returns these properties without geometry.

### GeocodeResult (geocoding endpoints)

`displayName` (full address, often Khmer), `lat`, `lon`, `hierarchy` (`{ province, district, commune, village, country }`, missing levels are `null`), `osmId`, `osmType`, `type`, `importance`, `rawAddress` (unmodified Nominatim address). Display "© OpenStreetMap contributors" when you show these results.

## Responses and errors

JSON endpoints wrap results in an envelope: `{ "success": true, "data": …, "meta"?: { "total", "source" } }`. GeoJSON endpoints return a bare `Feature` or `FeatureCollection` (no envelope) unless you ask for `format=summary`.

Errors use `{ "success": false, "data": null, "error": "…" }`. Real examples:

- Invalid id → `400` `{"success":false,"data":null,"error":"Invalid ID format. Must be a positive integer."}`
- Unknown id → `404` `{"success":false,"data":null,"error":"Item not found"}`
- Invalid level → `400` `{"success":false,"data":null,"error":"Invalid 'level' parameter. Allowed values: province, district, commune, village"}`

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success |
| 304 | Not modified (you sent a matching `If-None-Match`) |
| 400 | Invalid parameter: non-numeric id, unknown `level`, `q` too long, malformed coordinates |
| 403 | Missing `User-Agent` header |
| 404 | No place or boundary with that id/code |
| 405 | Method other than GET |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded; wait for `X-RateLimit-Reset` |
| 502/503 | Geocoding upstream (Nominatim) unavailable |

## Endpoints

### Administrative

The four-tier hierarchy as flat JSON records, without geometry. These are the endpoints for forms, address validation and lookups.

All responses use the `{ success, data, meta? }` envelope. Ids are numeric (e.g. 12 / 1201 / 120101 / 12010101).

**Rate limits:** 10,000 requests/min per IP for `/api/admin/*`, except `/api/admin/search` which is limited to 120 requests/min per IP.

#### List provinces

`GET /api/admin/provinces`

All 25 provinces and the capital, sorted by code.

Example: `GET https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/admin/provinces`

Response `200` (`application/json`); arrays are cut to the first 2 items (of 25), internal `_norm*` search fields are omitted:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "code": "01",
      "name": "Banteay Meanchey",
      "name_en": "Banteay Meanchey",
      "name_km": "បន្ទាយមានជ័យ",
      "level": "province",
      "lat": 13.6672,
      "lon": 102.8975,
      "typeKm": "ខេត្ត"
    },
    {
      "id": 2,
      "code": "02",
      "name": "Battambang",
      "name_en": "Battambang",
      "name_km": "បាត់ដំបង",
      "level": "province",
      "lat": 13.0957,
      "lon": 103.2022,
      "typeKm": "ខេត្ត"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "total": 25,
    "timestamp": "2026-10-27T00:00:00.000Z",
    "source": "local_cache"
  }
}
```

#### List districts of a province

`GET /api/admin/provinces/:id/districts`

Districts, khans and krongs belonging to a province.

| Parameter | In | | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | required | Province id (e.g. 12 for Phnom Penh). |

Example: `GET https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/admin/provinces/12/districts`

Response `200` (`application/json`); arrays are cut to the first 2 items (of 14), internal `_norm*` search fields are omitted:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1201,
      "code": "1201",
      "parentId": 12,
      "name": "Chamkar Mon",
      "name_en": "Chamkar Mon",
      "name_km": "ចំការមន",
      "level": "district",
      "typeKm": "ខណ្ឌ"
    },
    {
      "id": 1202,
      "code": "1202",
      "parentId": 12,
      "name": "Doun Penh",
      "name_en": "Doun Penh",
      "name_km": "ដូនពេញ",
      "level": "district",
      "typeKm": "ខណ្ឌ"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "total": 14,
    "timestamp": "2026-10-27T00:00:00.000Z",
    "source": "local_cache"
  }
}
```

#### Get a place

`GET /api/admin/item/:id`

A single record at any level, looked up by id. Returns 404 if the id does not exist.

| Parameter | In | | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | required | Id at any level (province, district, commune or village). |

Example: `GET https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/admin/item/1201`

Response `200` (`application/json`); internal `_norm*` search fields are omitted:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "id": 1201,
    "code": "1201",
    "parentId": 12,
    "name": "Chamkar Mon",
    "name_en": "Chamkar Mon",
    "name_km": "ចំការមន",
    "level": "district",
    "typeKm": "ខណ្ឌ"
  }
}
```

#### Resolve full path

`GET /api/admin/hierarchy/:id`

Returns the place and all its ancestors as an object keyed by level. Use it to render a full address from a single stored id.

| Parameter | In | | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | required | Id at any level (e.g. village 12010101). |

Example: `GET https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/admin/hierarchy/12010101`

Response `200` (`application/json`); internal `_norm*` search fields are omitted:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "village": {
      "id": 12010101,
      "code": "12010101",
      "parentId": 120101,
      "name": "Phum Muoy",
      "name_en": "Phum Muoy",
      "name_km": "ភូមិ ១",
      "level": "village",
      "typeKm": "ភូមិ"
    },
    "commune": {
      "id": 120101,
      "code": "120101",
      "parentId": 1201,
      "name": "Tonle Basak",
      "name_en": "Tonle Basak",
      "name_km": "ទន្លេបាសាក់",
      "level": "commune",
      "typeKm": "សង្កាត់"
    },
    "district": {
      "id": 1201,
      "code": "1201",
      "parentId": 12,
      "name": "Chamkar Mon",
      "name_en": "Chamkar Mon",
      "name_km": "ចំការមន",
      "level": "district",
      "typeKm": "ខណ្ឌ"
    },
    "province": {
      "id": 12,
      "code": "12",
      "name": "Phnom Penh",
      "name_en": "Phnom Penh",
      "name_km": "រាជធានីភ្នំពេញ",
      "level": "province",
      "lat": 11.5564,
      "lon": 104.9282,
      "typeKm": "រាជធានី"
    }
  }
}
```

#### Search places

`GET /api/admin/search`

Matches Khmer or English names, ignoring case, spaces and accents. Exact and prefix matches rank first.

Rate limit: 120 requests/min per IP. An empty `q` returns an empty list.

| Parameter | In | | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `q` | query | required | Search text, up to 50 characters. |
| `level` | query | optional | Restrict to one level: `province`, `district`, `commune` or `village`. |
| `limit` | query | optional | Results to return, 1-100. Default 20. |

Example: `GET https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/admin/search?q=siem%20reap&limit=5`

Response `200` (`application/json`); internal `_norm*` search fields are omitted:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 17,
      "code": "17",
      "name": "Siemreap",
      "name_en": "Siemreap",
      "name_km": "សៀមរាប",
      "level": "province",
      "lat": 13.3671,
      "lon": 103.8448,
      "typeKm": "ខេត្ត"
    }
  ],
  "meta": {
    "total": 1,
    "timestamp": "2026-10-27T00:00:00.000Z",
    "source": "local_cache"
  }
}
```

#### Dataset statistics

`GET /api/admin/stats`

Record counts per level and the last data sync time.

Example: `GET https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/admin/stats`

Response `200` (`application/json`):

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "provinces": 25,
    "districts": 210,
    "communes": 1661,
    "villages": 14576,
    "total": 16472,
    "lastSyncAt": "2026-10-27T00:00:00.000Z"
  }
}
```

### Boundaries

Polygons for provinces, districts and communes. List endpoints return GeoJSON by default (`application/geo+json`). Add `format=summary` to get lightweight JSON with centroids and bounding boxes but no coordinates. Boundary endpoints take the zero-padded code (e.g. `070203`), not the numeric id; PCODEs such as `KH12` are also accepted.

**Rate limit:** 10,000 requests/min per IP.

#### Query boundaries

`GET /api/boundaries`

Filter boundaries at any level. Without level it returns provinces. Supports pagination with limit and offset.

| Parameter | In | | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `level` | query | optional | `province`, `district` or `commune`. Defaults to province. |
| `province_code` | query | optional | Only children of this province. `provinceCode` is accepted as an alias. |
| `district_code` | query | optional | Only children of this district. `districtCode` is accepted as an alias. |
| `code` | query | optional | Exact code match (e.g. `12`, `1201`, `120101`). |
| `q` | query | optional | Name filter (Khmer or English). `search` is accepted as an alias. |
| `format` | query | optional | `geojson` (default, raw GeoJSON) or `summary` (lightweight `{ success, data }` JSON with centroids and bounding boxes, no coordinates). `list` is accepted as an alias of `summary`. |
| `limit` | query | optional | Max features to return. |
| `offset` | query | optional | Skip this many features (pagination). |

Example: `GET https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries?level=district&province_code=12&limit=3`

Response `200` (`application/geo+json`); arrays are cut to the first 2 items (of 3), geometry coordinates are abbreviated:

```json
{
  "type": "FeatureCollection",
  "name": "cambodia_district_boundaries",
  "crs": {
    "type": "name",
    "properties": {
      "name": "urn:ogc:def:crs:OGC:1.3:CRS84"
    }
  },
  "bbox": [
    102.3,
    10.4,
    107.7,
    14.7
  ],
  "features": [
    {
      "type": "Feature",
      "id": 1201,
      "properties": {
        "id": 1201,
        "code": "1201",
        "pcode": "KH1201",
        "name": "Chamkar Mon",
        "name_en": "Chamkar Mon",
        "name_km": "ចំការមន",
        "type_km": "ខណ្ឌ",
        "level": "district",
        "province_code": "12",
        "province_name_en": "Phnom Penh",
        "province_name_km": "រាជធានីភ្នំពេញ",
        "lat": 11.541901,
        "lon": 104.924774,
        "bbox": [
          104.898071,
          11.525696,
          104.951477,
          11.558105
        ],
        "shape_length": 0.140871782778,
        "shape_area": 0.000915726653145,
        "date": "2014/10/14",
        "validOn": "2018/10/04"
      },
      "geometry": {
        "type": "Polygon",
        "coordinates": "<1,196 bytes of coordinates>"
      },
      "bbox": [
        104.898071,
        11.525696,
        104.951477,
        11.558105
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "Feature",
      "id": 1212,
      "properties": {
        "id": 1212,
        "code": "1212",
        "pcode": "KH1212",
        "name": "Preaek Pnov",
        "name_en": "Preaek Pnov",
        "name_km": "ព្រែកព្នៅ",
        "type_km": "ខណ្ឌ",
        "level": "district",
        "province_code": "12",
```

#### Province boundaries

`GET /api/boundaries/provinces`

All 25 province polygons (about 1 MB as GeoJSON). Use format=summary for centroids and bounding boxes only.

| Parameter | In | | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `format` | query | optional | `geojson` (default, raw GeoJSON) or `summary` (lightweight `{ success, data }` JSON with centroids and bounding boxes, no coordinates). `list` is accepted as an alias of `summary`. |
| `q` | query | optional | Name filter (Khmer or English). `search` is accepted as an alias. |
| `code` | query | optional | Exact code match (e.g. `12`, `1201`, `120101`). |

Example: `GET https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries/provinces?format=summary`

Response `200` (`application/json`); arrays are cut to the first 2 items (of 25):

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [

      "id": 1,
      "code": "01",
```

#### District boundaries

`GET /api/boundaries/districts`

District polygons, usually filtered by province.

| Parameter | In | | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `province_code` | query | optional | Parent province code. `provinceCode` is accepted as an alias. |
| `code` | query | optional | Exact code match (e.g. `12`, `1201`, `120101`). |
| `q` | query | optional | Name filter (Khmer or English). `search` is accepted as an alias. |
| `format` | query | optional | `geojson` (default, raw GeoJSON) or `summary` (lightweight `{ success, data }` JSON with centroids and bounding boxes, no coordinates). `list` is accepted as an alias of `summary`. |
| `limit` | query | optional | Max features to return. |
| `offset` | query | optional | Skip this many features (pagination). |

#### Boundary by any code

`GET /api/boundaries/item/:code`

Detects the level from the code length. Handy when you don't know the level in advance.

| Parameter | In | | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | path | required | Any province, district or commune code. |
| `format` | query | optional | `geojson` (default, raw GeoJSON) or `summary` (lightweight `{ success, data }` JSON with centroids and bounding boxes, no coordinates). `list` is accepted as an alias of `summary`. |

Example: `GET https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries/item/1201`

#### Boundary zone by coordinates

`GET /api/boundaries/zone`

Sub-millisecond in-memory Point-in-Polygon spatial query resolving the containing administrative boundary zone (Province, District, Commune) for a given GPS coordinate.

| Parameter | In | | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lat` | query | required | Latitude (-90 to 90). |
| `lng` | query | required | Longitude (-180 to 180; 'lon' also accepted). |
| `level` | query | optional | 'all' (default, 3-tier hierarchy), 'province', 'district' or 'commune'. |
| `format` | query | optional | 'geojson' (default, GeoJSON FeatureCollection/Feature), 'json' or 'summary'. |

Example: `GET https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries/zone?lat=11.5564&lng=104.9282`

Response `200` (`application/geo+json`); arrays are cut to the first 2 items (of 3), geometry coordinates are abbreviated:

```json
{
  "type": "FeatureCollection",
  "name": "cambodia_zone_boundaries",
  "crs": {
    "type": "name",
    "properties": {
      "name": "urn:ogc:def:crs:OGC:1.3:CRS84"
    }
  },
  "bbox": [
    104.712708,
    11.421509,
    105.049072,
    11.736511
  ],
  "features": [
    {
      "type": "Feature",
      "id": 12,
      "properties": {
        "id": 12,
        "code": "12",
        "pcode": "KH12",
        "name": "Phnom Penh",
        "name_en": "Phnom Penh",
        "name_km": "រាជធានីភ្នំពេញ",
        "type_km": "រាជធានី",
        "level": "province",
        "province_code": "12",
        "province_name_en": "Phnom Penh",
        "province_name_km": "រាជធានីភ្នំពេញ",
        "lat": 11.5564,
        "lon": 104.9282,
        "bbox": [
          104.712708,
          11.421509,
          105.049072,
          11.736511
        ],
        "shape_length": 1.45685991518,
        "shape_area": 0.0567541588326,
        "date": "2014/10/14",
        "validOn": "2018/10/04"
      },
      "geometry": {
        "type": "Polygon",
        "coordinates": "<13,039 bytes of coordinates>"
      },
      "bbox": [
        104.712708,
        11.421509,
        105.049072,
        11.736511
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "Feature",
      "id": 1201,
      "properties": {
        "id": 1201,
        "code": "1201",
        "pcode": "KH1201",
        "name": "Chamkar Mon",
```

#### Boundary with ancestors

`GET /api/boundaries/hierarchy/:code`

The Feature for a code plus its parent district and province Features, keyed by level. Returned inside the `{ success, data }` envelope.

| Parameter | In | | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | path | required | Commune or district code. |

Example: `GET https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries/hierarchy/120101`

Response `200` (`application/json`); geometry coordinates are abbreviated:

```json
{
```

#### Boundary statistics

`GET /api/boundaries/stats`

Polygon counts per level, the national bounding box and the data source.

Example: `GET https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries/stats`

Response `200` (`application/json`):

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "provinces": 25,
    "districts": 197,
    "communes": 1633,
    "total": 1855,
    "levels": [
      "province",
      "district",
      "commune"
    ],
    "bbox": [
      102.3,
      10.4,
      107.7,
      14.7
    ],
    "isLoaded": true,
    "source": "Department of Geography, Ministry of Land Management, Urban Planning and Construction / MEF Open Data"
  }
}
```

#### Download raw GeoJSON

`GET /api/boundaries/raw/:filename`

The full source file as an attachment (`Content-Disposition: attachment`). Large download.

| Parameter | In | | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filename` | path | required | provinces.geojson, districts.geojson or communes.geojson (singular forms also accepted). |

Example: `GET https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries/raw/provinces.geojson`

### Geocoding

Address lookups backed by OpenStreetMap Nominatim, normalised into Cambodia's hierarchy and cached for a week.

**Rate limit:** 30 requests/min per IP (respects OSM usage policy).

#### Reverse geocode

`GET /api/geocode/reverse`

Turn coordinates into an address mapped to Cambodia's hierarchy. Returns 400 for missing/invalid coordinates, 404 if nothing is found, 503 if the upstream service is unavailable.

| Parameter | In | | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lat` | query | required | Latitude, decimal degrees [-90, 90]. |
| `lon` | query | required | Longitude, decimal degrees [-180, 180]. |

Example: `GET https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/geocode/reverse?lat=11.5564&lon=104.9282`

Response: `data` is a GeocodeResult (search: an array of them). See the data model above.

#### Forward geocode

`GET /api/geocode/search`

Find addresses, landmarks and points of interest in Cambodia by name. An empty `q` returns an empty list.

| Parameter | In | | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `q` | query | required | Search text, up to 100 characters. |
| `limit` | query | optional | Results to return, 1-50. Default 10. |

Example: `GET https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/geocode/search?q=Angkor%20Wat&limit=3`

Response: `data` is a GeocodeResult (search: an array of them). See the data model above.

### System

Service metadata, health and machine-readable documentation. These responses do not use the `{ success, data }` envelope.

**Rate limit:** `/api/info` falls under the general API limit of 5,000 requests/min per IP.

#### API root

`GET /`

Welcome document with links to documentation and key endpoints. Browsers (Accept: text/html) get the web app instead; send `Accept: application/json` or `?json=1` for JSON.

Example: `GET https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/`

#### Health check

`GET /health`

Liveness probe with uptime.

Example: `GET https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/health`

Response `200` (`application/json`):

```json
{
  "status": "ok",
  "uptimeSeconds": 0,
  "timestamp": "2026-11-09T11:48:28.751Z",
  "security": {
    "timestamp": "2026-11-09T11:48:28.751Z",
    "prototypePollutionProtected": false,
    "configSealed": false,
    "allowedOutboundHosts": [
      "nominatim.openstreetmap.org",
      "overpass-api.de",
      "opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me",
      "localhost",
      "127.0.0.1"
    ]
  }
}
```

#### API index

`GET /api/info`

Machine-readable list of every endpoint and the level conventions.

Example: `GET https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/info`

#### llms.txt

`GET /llms.txt`

Concise API summary for LLMs (llmstxt.org standard).

Example: `GET https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/llms.txt`

#### llms-full.txt

`GET /llms-full.txt`

Full API reference for LLMs (llmstxt.org standard).

Example: `GET https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/llms-full.txt`

#### Postman collection

`GET /opengeo-cambodia.postman_collection.json`

This Postman collection as JSON. `/postman` redirects here.

Example: `GET https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/opengeo-cambodia.postman_collection.json`

## Recipes

### Cascading address picker

```ts
const API = "https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/admin";
const get = async (path: string) => {
  const body = await fetch(API + path).then((r) => r.json());
  if (!body.success) throw new Error(body.error);
  return body.data as { id: number; code: string; name_en: string; name_km: string }[];
};

const provinces = await get("/provinces");                       // 25
const districts = await get(`/provinces/${provinces[0].id}/districts`);
const communes  = await get(`/districts/${districts[0].id}/communes`);
const villages  = await get(`/communes/${communes[0].id}/villages`);
```

Cache the province and district lists on your side; they change rarely.

### Full address from one stored id

```python
import requests

r = requests.get("https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/admin/hierarchy/12010101",
                 headers={"User-Agent": "my-app/1.0"}, timeout=10).json()
h = r["data"]  # keys: province, district, commune, village
print(", ".join(h[k]["name_en"] for k in ("village", "commune", "district", "province") if k in h))
```

### Draw boundaries on a map

```js
// Leaflet: districts of Phnom Penh (code 12). Response is a bare FeatureCollection.
const fc = await fetch("https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries/districts?province_code=12").then((r) => r.json());
L.geoJSON(fc, { onEachFeature: (f, layer) => layer.bindTooltip(f.properties.name_en) }).addTo(map);
```

Use `format=summary` when you only need names, centroids or bounding boxes (much smaller than full polygons).

### Search-as-you-type

Debounce input by ~200 ms and call `GET /api/admin/search?q=…&limit=8`. It matches Khmer or English, ignores case, spaces and accents, ranks exact and prefix matches first, and accepts `level` to restrict results. Mind the 120 requests/min limit and the 50-character cap on `q`.

## Gotchas for agents

1. **Send a `User-Agent`.** Without one every request is rejected with 403.
2. **id vs code.** Admin URLs take numeric ids (`70203`); boundary URLs take zero-padded codes (`070203`). Passing an id to a boundary endpoint usually 404s for codes with a leading zero.
3. **Not every place has a polygon.** The boundary dataset predates recent reorganisations: 197 of 210 districts and 1,633 of 1,661 communes have boundaries; villages have none. Treat 404 from boundary endpoints as "no polygon", not as "no such place".
4. **Always pass `level` to `GET /api/boundaries`.** Without it the endpoint returns all provinces and ignores the other filters.
5. **GeoJSON responses have no envelope.** Check `type === "FeatureCollection"` instead of `success`, unless you request `format=summary`.
6. **Ignore fields starting with `_`.** They are internal search indexes.
7. **Geocoding is external and slow-limited** (30/min, results cached for a week). Prefer the admin search for names you already know; use geocoding for street addresses and coordinates.
8. **`/` serves the web app to browsers.** Send `Accept: application/json` (or `?json=1`) to get the JSON welcome document.

## AI Agent Tool Definitions (Function Calling)

Standard JSON Schemas for OpenAI Function Calling, Anthropic Tool Use, LangChain, and LlamaIndex agents:

### 1. search_cambodia_admin
```json
{
  "type": "function",
  "function": {
    "name": "search_cambodia_admin",
    "description": "Search Cambodian administrative geography (provinces, districts, communes, villages) by Khmer or English name",
    "parameters": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "q": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Search keyword in English or Khmer script (e.g. 'Phnom Penh', 'សៀមរាប', 'Chamkar Mon')"
        },
        "level": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "province",
            "district",
            "commune",
            "village"
          ],
          "description": "Optional filter by administrative level"
        },
        "limit": {
          "type": "integer",
          "default": 5,
          "description": "Maximum records to return (1-50)"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "q"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

### 2. point_in_polygon_cambodia
```json
{
  "type": "function",
  "function": {
    "name": "point_in_polygon_cambodia",
    "description": "Instant sub-millisecond Point-in-Polygon spatial query resolving the containing Province, District, and Commune for a given GPS coordinate in Cambodia",
    "parameters": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "lat": {
          "type": "number",
          "description": "GPS Latitude in decimal degrees (e.g. 11.5564)"
        },
        "lng": {
          "type": "number",
          "description": "GPS Longitude in decimal degrees (e.g. 104.9282)"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "lat",
        "lng"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

### 3. get_cambodia_hierarchy
```json
{
  "type": "function",
  "function": {
    "name": "get_cambodia_hierarchy",
    "description": "Retrieve complete administrative hierarchy ancestry (province, district, commune, village) from a single numeric ID",
    "parameters": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "integer",
          "description": "Numeric administrative ID (e.g. 12, 1201, 120101, 12010101)"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "id"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## Agent Configuration (.cursorrules / .windsurfrules)

```text
When dealing with Cambodian geographic data, administrative codes, or address selection:
- Consult https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/llms.txt for authoritative NCDD hierarchy.
- Adhere to Cambodia's 4-tier system: Province (2-digit code) -> District (4-digit code) -> Commune (6-digit code) -> Village (8-digit code).
- Use https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/admin/search?q={query} for place resolution.
- Use https://opengeo-cambodia.pphat.me/api/boundaries/zone?lat={lat}&lng={lng} for coordinate containment.
- Always send a User-Agent header in HTTP requests.
```
